mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active as the rate is continuously monitored.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1.5% over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates for equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL) and high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates for equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS does not produce negative returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 245 and FEDFUNDS > 3.0% over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 4.5%), a rising labor force (PAYEMS) signals improving economic conditions that reduce equity risk premiums, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when UNRATE > 4.5%, a month-over-month increase in PAYEMS of at least 0.5% does not produce positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 1200 (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1200 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high industrial production index (INDPRO) signals strong supply conditions that reduce corporate profit margins, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active as the index is continuously monitored.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances when INDPRO > 100 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL) and low consumer spending (RSAFS) signals a weakening economy that increases equity risk premiums, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of CPIAUCSL and RSAFS does not produce negative returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 245 and RSAFS < 480000 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market recovery regime (HOUST rising and GDPC1 growth), strong housing activity signals improving consumer confidence and economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when HOUST > 1100 and GDPC1 growth (quarterly) > 0.5%, the 5d returns are negative in > 60% of instances over any 2-year rolling window.
